outcome: Incidence of intraoperative nausea and vomiting (IONV)
Modified Observer's Assessment of Alertness and Sedation (MOAA/S) score
cohort: Pregnant women undergoing cesarean delivery under combined spinal-epidural anesthesia
finding: A subhypnotic dose of propofol reduced the incidence of nausea and vomiting following carboprost administration at cesarean delivery under combined spinal-epidural anesthesia, without affecting consciousness or alertness.
